title: Wire API repositories

context.summary: Connect the API server to the Drizzle repository layer for core project, peer, session, document, memory and context endpoints.
context.background: TASK-14 added repository skeletons. TASK-15 builds the first runtime dependency graph for Fastify without wiring storage/queue upload runtime, auth token verification, jobs or vector search.

in: Add API runtime dependency builder that creates database repositories from config.
Add peer routes backed by PeerRepository.
Add session and message routes backed by SessionRepository.
Wire memory routes through MemoryService and DbMemoryRepository.
Wire context build through ContextBuilder, DbSessionRepository, DbMemoryRepository and document chunk search.
Add document read, status, list and text-search routes backed by document repositories.
Map repository not-found errors to API 404 responses.
Add API runtime wiring validation to repository checks.
Update API, architecture, database and README docs.
out: Wire document upload storage and queue runtime.
Wire BullMQ workers or processing job API routes.
Implement token verification or auth scopes.
Implement vector search or pgvector migrations.
Run migrations or API server against live PostgreSQL.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/api depends on @mindory/db for server runtime wiring.
API server builds runtime dependencies from Mindory config and passes them to buildApiApp.
Project, peer, session, message, memory, context and document read/status/list/search routes use injected repositories/services when available.
Default app factory still supports dependency injection for tests and explicit placeholders when dependencies are omitted.
Repository not-found errors are returned as structured 404 API errors.
Document upload remains explicitly unwired until storage and queue runtime are added.
Jobs, auth token verification and vector search remain future tasks.
Repository checks include API runtime wiring validation.

commands: ls apps/api/src/runtime.ts apps/api/src/routes/peers.ts apps/api/src/routes/sessions.ts packages/db/src/client.ts scripts/validate-api-runtime-wiring.js
manual_checks: Confirm API runtime imports @mindory/db only in runtime wiring, not MCP/CLI/Hermes.
Confirm document upload, jobs, auth token verification and vector search remain out of scope.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
The API runtime is structurally validated but not exercised against a live PostgreSQL database in this task.
Some CLI/MCP/Hermes paths still target planned endpoints such as token creation and jobs.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
